No Challenge, Auto Battle, AP spend, refill, Sweep, Blitz, or Auto Complete input is permitted.

cost_quantity_requirements.notes: Every AP-consuming, combat, refill, purchase, or premium path is prohibited.

bounded_recovery_behavior: recognized Campaign exit or canonical Home preparation only; otherwise block
evidence_requirements: three consecutive post-repair supervised BlueStacks navigation-only results accepted as representative coverage
native source, immediate-before, post, terminal, events, ledger, capability audit, and journal evidence
zero AP, premium, refill, combat, purchase, registration, or scheduler input

replay_fixture_requirements.notes: Zero-transport handler and pnsctl delegation coverage.

live_validation_scenarios.notes: Three consecutive post-repair cycles, one for each supported destination; each cycle is independently retained and no gameplay execution is authorized.
